<b>Overgrown Pilgrims</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are aged pilgrims capable of spitting moss from within their stomachs.<ref>Overgrown Pilgrim [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] entry: <i>"Aged pilgrim, overgrown with lichen and moss. The moss looks to grow even inside their stomach, which the pilgrim spits at foes in compressed gobs. A foul form of offence."</i></ref>

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Overgrown Pilgrims naturally wander, walking until they reach an edge or a wall, in which case they turn around and continue walking.
Overgrown Pilgrims do not pursue Hornet, but alternate between the following moves if she is in range:
* <b>Leap:</b> Leaps backwards a set distance, though they will shorten their leap to prevent going past the edge of a platform. If they are already at the edge of a platform, they instead perform a short jump forwards. This move is always immediately followed up with Moss Spit.
* <b>Moss Spit:</b> Spits out a glob of moss at Hornet, which arcs through the air and disappears on impact with a surface. The projectile can be struck with the [[Needle]] to destroy it and create an opening for attack.
** Overgrown Pilgrims can sometimes be found stationary at the edge of platforms. When in this state, they do not use Retreat Leap and relentlessly try to prevent Hornet from jumping to their platform. They go back to normal behaviour once Hornet lands on their platform.

Attacking from above can be effective for avoiding their projectiles or, alternatively, just hitting the moss globs to get rid of them and staying on the Overgrown Pilgrim as they try to retreat.

=== Act 3 ===
[[Black-Threading|Black-threaded]] Overgrown Pilgrims have their health quadrupled. They can gain any of the standard [[Black-Threading#Movesets|void attacks]].

== Location ==
Overgrown Pilgrims can be found primarily in [[Mosshome]], though one can be found in a secret room in the eastern [[Wormways]] and another near the entrance to this location in [[Bonegrave]].
